comments.author: UselessAqua
comments.body_html:
This is a cool mod. I’m glad that I found this.

But I have some questions about the mod.**

  • When I want to “store” an item, I’m getting 49% of the value that it would cost to buy it back. Is this fee intended so that you don’t store all the items inside the trader?
  • I guess money can’t be stored, because logic, you can’t give money for money. Except if you give some other currency as exchange. Would it be possible to add the ability to exchange/store currencies?
  • It can’t be changed, that items lose their Found in Raid tag when bought back, right?
  • I looked inside the SharedStashTrader.json file to see how it was configured. Because some items can’t be sold to the stash, like knives, packaged ammo or gear under 60% durability.
  • Some of the IDs are only in items_buy or sell_category. Also, there are some duplicate IDs in those two categories.
  • Is the repair cost intended to go up with increased loyalty levels?

comments.author: GOODYOB
comments.body_html: Is there any way to change buy/sell prices?

comments.author: UselessAqua
comments.body_html:
BEFORE YOU DO ANYTHING, MAKE A BACKUP OF AT LEAST THIS MOD AND YOUR PROFILE!

Yes, you need a basic text editor for it.

  • Go into …\SPT\user\mods\PaulovsSharedStashTrader\src\Traders\db
  • Open the SharedStashTrader.json file
  • Search for “buy_price_coef” under “loyaltyLevels”
  • You will find mutliple “buy_price_coef”, one per loyality level
  • Top most is level 1, 2nd level 2, etc.
  • Change “buy_price_coef” to your liking the value is a percentage
  • High value means you get less money for the stuff you sell, lower value mean you get more money.
  • There is maybe no cap, and yes the value can be negative, tested it with -10000
